ToxicDriedLakebedExt02-10 |refid ={{ID|00262b2f}} |keywords =* {{Location keyword FO76|LocRegionToxicValley}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocThemeWorkingClass}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeFastTravelDestination}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocLootScaleSmall}} * {{Location keyword FO76|LocTypeClearable}} |edid =SubToxicToxicDriedLakebedLocation }} The '''toxic dried lakebed''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] in the [[Toxic Valley]] region of [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== The lake was once a popular location for tourists and boaters. ==Layout== This lakebed is a stretch of dried-up land that separates [[Clarksburg]] and [[Wavy Willard's Water Park]], irradiated from chemical dumping and the effects of the Great War. Its point of discovery is within Clarksburg, near an inaccessible [[Crab Shack]] and [[Big Steve's Sporting Goods]]. There is a pathway that leads up to the roof of the restaurant, where there is a small survivalist's camp with some loot. There are a number of other buildings along the edge of the lake including boathouses, one of which is locked and has a red [[Steamer trunk (Fallout 76)|steamer trunk]] inside. There is also a diner named [[Lakeside Grill]] with various [[Fallout 76 junk items|junk item]] inside. At the center of the lake is a spawn for a large creature such as a [[Mirelurk (Fallout 76)#Mirelurk queen|mirelurk queen]] or a [[Grafton Monster]]. ==Notable loot== * [[Untitled]] - Note, found on a picnic table on a small wharf, slightly east of the diner. * [[Boat house key]] - In the diner, near a bubblegum bear in a cooking pot. It opens the locked boathouse. * Potential [[Fallout 76 weapon mods|weapon mod]] - Inside the locked boathouse at the pier, on a metal shelf. ==Appearances== The toxic dried lakebed appears only {{In|FO76}}. ==Gallery== Toxic dried lakebed.png|Dock FO76 Crab Shack sign.png|Crab Shack sign {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Fallout 76 locations]] [[Category:Toxic Valley locations]] [[Category:Lakes]] [[fr:Lac asséché toxique]] [[ru:Ядовитое высохшее озеро]] [[zh:有毒乾涸河床]]

Whitespring driving range.content:
{{Infobox location |games =FO76 |type =unmarked |image =FO76 WS Driving range 2.png |part of =[[Springhill Golf Course]] |owners =[[Fritz]] |creatures =[[Feral ghoul (Fallout 76)|Feral ghouls]] |cell name =WhitespringGolfExt |refid ={{ID|00262c2f}} }} The '''Whitespring driving range''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|location]] on [[the Whitespring grounds]] in [[Appalachia]]. ==Background== A part of the expansive [[Springhill Golf Course]], now home to [[Fritz]] in the outbuilding and surrounded by [[Feral ghoul (Fallout 76)|feral ghouls]]. ==Layout== The range is a feature of the golf course, down the hill from the [[The Whitespring Golf Club|clubhouse]]. The course stretches around the perimeter of driving range, encompassing a small piece of the resort to the east of the main entrance. A small building and adjacent facilities include a raised, flat, driving area, [[Golf cart (Fallout 76)|golf cart]] parking, and bridged paths to the rest of the course. Several benches line the range to the south. Inside the building is various junk, a sleeping bag, and golfing accoutrements such as several [[golf club]]s and bags. Fritz lives here, and will attempt to convince the [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]] that they are a part of high society. If pressed, they will admit they are a former [[Crater Raiders|raider]] but are enjoying this lifestyle much more.[[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"[Perception 4+] Love your little get-up. Did you loot it off some bodies around here?"''
Fritz: ''"Get-up? Well, I never-! Alright, you got me. I'm a Raider who's got nothing better to do, okay? I spend my days fending off irradiated montrosities to survive, anyway. Why not make some fun out of it?"'' ==Appearances== The Whitespring driving range appears in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 WS Driving range 1.png FO76 Golf cart chillen.png FO76 Fritz blast zone.png|Fritz snoozing through a nuclear blast ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:The Whitespring]]
